tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Who TBG (The Brett Group) is, what it offers homeowners, investors and contractors in Annapolis / Anne Arundel County, Maryland, how matching works and what it costs (free to homeowners).

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Checks whether TBG serves a Maryland ZIP code or town for home projects, and which office issues building permits there.

tools.name: get_local_permit_guidance
tools.description: Plain-English permit guidance for a home project in Annapolis or Anne Arundel County, MD: county vs City of Annapolis, Land Use Navigator, Chesapeake Bay Critical Area, historic district, plus local considerations for the town.

tools.name: get_hiring_checklist
tools.description: Maryland rules for hiring a home improvement contractor, with official sources: MHIC license lookup, one-third deposit cap, required contract terms, $500K insurance, the $30,000 Guaranty Fund, trade licenses, liens and permits.

tools.name: list_project_options
tools.description: Returns the valid values for project types, scopes, timelines, budgets, loan types and partner types, plus the consent text a person agrees to when sending TBG a request.

tools.name: submit_project_request
tools.description: Ask TBG to match a homeowner with one licensed partner contractor for a remodel, addition, basement, deck/exterior or new custom home in Annapolis / Anne Arundel County, MD. tools.name: submit_lending_inquiry
tools.description: Send TBG a real estate investor's loan inquiry (fix-and-flip, ground-up construction or bridge) for non-owner-occupied property in Maryland. Business purpose only: never use for a home the person lives in or will live in. Not an application or commitment to lend. Accepted only with business_purpose_

tools.name: contact_tbg
tools.description: Send TBG a build-to-rent inquiry (landowner, co-investor, builder partner) or another question. Home projects go through submit_project_request and loans through submit_lending_inquiry. Accepted only with user_consented=true.

tools.name: apply_to_network
tools.description: Submit an application for a contractor, trade, home builder, architect/engineer, lender, agent/broker, property manager or supplier to join the TBG network in Maryland. Accepted only with user_consented=true (the applicant agrees to be contacted about joining).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_service_area · Private data: submit_project_request, contact_tbg · Public sink: submit_project_request, submit_lending_inquiry, contact_tbg, apply_to_network.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_service_area · Private data: submit_project_request, contact_tbg · Public sink: submit_project_request, submit_lending_inquiry, contact_tbg, apply_to_network

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
